note: SIMULATION ONLY. Forgetting rule F1 for ESL6 learner simulator; v2, revised after validation round 1 (v1 failed the forgetting check); all v2 parameters fixed before re-checking. See LEARNING_RULES.md section 6.
runs: once per simulated day outside a session; never inside a session; order per day: correct_decay then wrong_return

retrieval.definition: recall item from an earlier session answered from memory (right or wrong) for each tested correct belief; not if previous turn settled the answer; post-test items and session-1 items do not count

wrong_return.applies_to: wrong belief below band starting strength at end of last session and not reset to 0 by R4 (count reached 2)
wrong_return.rate_formula: fraction_of_drop_per_day * retrieval_multiplier ** r(Ck); cap = cap_fraction_of_drop_per_gap * retrieval_multiplier ** r(Ck) (r of the paired correct belief, cap 2)

answering.correct_belief_floor: Wk error prob on an item testing Ck is at least max_floor_error_prob * max(0, 1 - Ck / full_recall_strength)
answering.applies_from: session 2 onward (any answer after at least one F1 interval)
answering.v1_replaced: hard threshold: Ck < 1.0 -> at least 0.4, else none
